findings.highlight: We will use that opening to fight Caster.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺と遠坂はキャスターたちと対決する
findings.governingReading: While Lancer separates Archer and Saber, Shirou and Rin confront Caster and her associates, including Kuzuki.
findings.explanation: Caster's side is reduced to Caster alone in the role confirmation.

findings.highlight: She wouldn't tell us even if we asked
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が訊いてもランサーが茶化しても教えてくれなかった
findings.governingReading: Shirou did ask and Lancer did needle Rin, but she refused to explain to either.
findings.explanation: An actual failed inquiry and Lancer's teasing become a hypothetical question.

findings.highlight: Projection has become my primary weapon.
findings.evidenceJa: 投影は、自分にとってただ一つの戦力になっている
findings.governingReading: ただ一つ explicitly says Projection is his sole combat asset at this point.
findings.explanation: Projection as Shirou's only fighting power becomes merely his primary weapon.

findings.highlight: The sky is closer to black than gray
findings.evidenceJa: 黒というより灰に近い空
findings.governingReading: The sky is closer to ash/gray than black, recalling the scene ten years earlier.
findings.explanation: The sky's color comparison is reversed.

findings.highlight: he lets us go but confronts Lancer.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺たちは見逃してランサーだけでも撃退するか
findings.governingReading: If Archer lets the pair pass, he can at least try to drive Lancer off and fulfill his gatekeeper role.
findings.explanation: Archer's alternative of repelling Lancer is weakened to merely confronting him.

findings.highlight: She's a great Master, but I'm not one who is able to betray my Master readily.
findings.evidenceJa: おいそれと主を裏切れない身としちゃあ、少しばかり眩しいってもんだ
findings.governingReading: Speaking as someone who cannot readily betray his own master, Lancer finds the gratitude just described a little dazzling.
findings.explanation: Lancer's admission that Rin's gratitude dazzles him becomes praise of her as a Master. His loyalty constraint remains, but the personal effect of her thanks is less specific.
